payload.title: DIP-L02: Ship repository-contained skills and a portable intent fallback
payload.description:
Implementation gap. QA baseline: DIP v0.3.2, 6 October 2026.

AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md travel with Git, but automatic per-project .agents/.claude skill generation and a complete intent writer independent of global DIP installation are not implemented. Full runtime use currently requires Node.js 24+ and installation on each execution host.

Evidence and starting points: src/core.js, skills/dip/SKILL.md, docs/compatibility.md.

This is unassigned contributor backlog, not implemented work. Preserve the existing license, DCO and local/offline defaults.
acceptance: Generate supported repository skill entry points without overwriting unrelated project instructions or user skills; preserve a versioned upgrade/removal path.
A fresh clone without globally installed DIP can read outstanding intent and save a plan, future idea and handoff using a documented portable path.
Prove that portable events project and merge correctly through the standard runtime, including divergent updates and corrupt-history diagnostics.
Clearly distinguish portable intent persistence from automatic capture/live leases; do not silently install or execute untrusted cloned scripts.
